titel: Listen to this if you're feeling discouraged

einzeiler: How to overcome creative burnout and why you should never give up on your dreams.
kurzfassung: Sumi talks about the exhaustion and discouragement many creatives face due to constant marketing pressure and algorithmic demands. Sharing her own experiences from selling a government consulting business to building a music career, she emphasizes that trusting your own voice matters more than online guru formulas. Ultimately, she encourages creatives to push past moments of doubt by remembering two simple words: keep going.
stichpunkte: Creatives face widespread discouragement due to algorithms, AI competition, and the exhaustion of constant online marketing.
The pressure to follow formulas from online gurus drains the authentic soul out of artistic creation.
Two simple words can transform a career during moments of wanting to quit: keep going.
Selling a 200-person government consulting firm required intense due diligence and left Sumi feeling completely burned out.
A mentor's simple advice to keep going during the company sale process ultimately enabled her transition into a full-time music career.
Recent milestones like performing the single American Dream on a late-night show and receiving a Hollywood Independent Music Award nomination prove that momentum is building.
Art remains essential for connecting humanity, especially amid political chaos and technological disruption.

clips.hook: AI artists and broken algorithms are wearing creatives down.
clips.text: Independent musicians struggle to gain visibility on streaming platforms as automated recommendations shift and software-generated tracks flood the market.

clips.hook: Why a blueprint for creativity is a total oxymoron.
clips.text: Rigid multi-step formulas that promise to unlock artistic innovation are fundamentally absurd.

clips.hook: The two simple words that can save your creative career.
clips.text: Decades of experience launching various business ventures prove that persistence matters more than a linear path to achievement.

clips.hook: When running two full-time jobs makes you want to scream.
clips.text: After an exhausting six-hour discussion, a struggling founder called an advisor during a walk to vent frustrations and came close to walking away right before a breakthrough.

clips.hook: Why the world needs your art now more than ever.
clips.text: Amid political upheaval and rapid technological changes driven by artificial intelligence, creative expression remains essential for fostering human connection.

beschreibung:
Feeling discouraged? You're not alone.
In this solo episode, I talk about why so many creatives are feeling stuck in today's oversaturated world and how I've learned to keep going anyway. From leaving behind my career in government consulting to pursuing music in Los Angeles, I share my thoughts on algorithms, comparison, authenticity, and why your creativity is worth protecting. If you've been questioning your path, this episode is your reminder to keep creating and keep believing.
